causalrelay.features: existing source-only pretreatment feature set; no receiver outcomes/interventions at deployment

selection.primary_metric: design-weighted out-of-fold mean squared error on Delta_budget

chronology_disclosure: This protocol is motivated by observed Stage-1 discovery evidence and is not described as part of the original preregistration.

hypotheses.claim_rule: report magnitude and clustered uncertainty; no arbitrary success threshold
hypotheses.estimand: distribution/variance of Delta_budget over eligible candidates

hypotheses.claim_rule: direction and uncertainty reported; negative alignment is not assumed
hypotheses.estimand: Cov(T, Delta_budget), G_obs, G_rand, G_star, eta_U where defined

hypotheses.claim_rule: compare candidate family against role-only-mean floor on the frozen CV metric
CausalRelay versus Uniform, Head, Vanilla and reproduced SOTA; all results reported
hypotheses.estimand: paired differences in A and C_comm at matched budget

hypotheses.claim_rule: robustness only; no final-panel generality claim
hypotheses.estimand: same frozen policy/system messages evaluated under all four preview model rows

hypotheses.claim_rule: secondary preview evidence; no false data-processing-inequality claim
hypotheses.estimand: A^(h), Tbar^(h), Rbar0^(h) at h in [1,2,3,5]

inference.under_stochastic_receiver: retain decode replicate level exactly as selected by operational audit

interventions.budget_neutral: existing matched insert/evict semantics; Delta_budget != Delta_avail
interventions.sham: mechanism-specific negative control only, not proof of neutrality

preview_competitiveness_label.condition: descriptive only: CausalRelay point estimates exceed both UniformAtomsSameRenderer and VanillaRelay on A and C_comm under the primary preview configuration
preview_competitiveness_label.label: PROF_REVIEW_DIRECTIONALLY_COMPETITIVE

primary_preview_question: Under a fixed textual handoff budget, are natural relay decisions misaligned with budget-neutral causal information value, and can a source-only CausalRelay policy improve endpoint fidelity and causal communication contribution without relying on post-treatment information?

sampling.focal_design: existing role-stratified without-replacement design and recorded pi_iz

sota_language: Professor-preview comparisons may report paired estimates/CIs and a PREVIEW superiority signal, but may not claim final SOTA superiority.

stage1_motivating_signal.interpretation: Availability value exists while natural assignment-effect alignment was strongly negative in Stage-1 discovery. This motivates, but does not confirm, a budget-neutral targeting hypothesis.
